headline: Quantum Engineering: Control, Tomography, and Codes
summary: Today's selection highlights practical advances in quantum control and state characterization alongside algebraic foundations for quantum advantages. Highlights range from global drive engineering in trapped ions and resource-aware neutrino simulations to algebraic guarantees in state tomography and secret sharing.

themes.title: Quantum Simulation and Control
themes.body: Novel drive and circuit engineering approaches push the scale and fidelity of quantum simulators, from fault-tolerant neutrino dynamics to trapped-ion interaction graphs.

themes.title: State Reconstruction and Tomography
themes.body: Advances in identifying quantum states, leveraging photo-assisted mapping to measure electronic entanglement and quartic certificates to ensure pure-state uniqueness with fewer Paulis.

themes.title: Algebraic Structures and Open Systems
themes.body: Leveraging algebraic tools to protect quantum information, from dissipative decoherence-free subspace engineering to polynomial intersection bounds in secret sharing.

connections.body: Both papers use algebraic operator constraints—elementary symmetric polynomials and Lie algebra representation theory—to guarantee protected or unique quantum subspaces.
